issues: The summary turns the end of the ninth year into a concurrent event with Alma's return, though the verses do not specify that simultaneity.
Amulek is named in the characters field though he is identified only as “a man” in the cited verse; his identification comes in the next scene.

Scene combines Alma 8:30 and 8:32, two separately reported moments with unspecified elapsed time; its notes correctly caution not to merge their actions, but the combined summary and narration risk presenting a unified scene.
Alma 8:30 identifies Alma and Amulek as the antecedents of “they” in Alma 8:31. The scene incorrectly treats the recipients of power as unidentified.
The supplied verses do not identify Mormon as the narrator; listing him as a character and asserting his identity exceeds the source.
The preceding scene includes Alma 8:32, so placing this report from Alma 8:31 afterward reverses the supplied narrative order.
